Subject: Mod->Flat pricing conversion: options & timeline

Hi Sven —

Thanks for the call this morning. To recap, Novacare is interested in moving from our modular pricing model (multiple add-on SKUs per feature) to a single flat monthly rate for predictability across teams. I pulled together two high-level conversion approaches so we can align on the right path before I loop in finance/procurement:

1) One-time consolidation (recommended for orgs that want simple billing)
   - Convert entitlements into a flat seat+throughput SKU
   - One-time conversion fee to cover retooling and prorated credits
   - Small guaranteed discount (volume-based) for committing 12+ months

2) Phased feature migration (recommended for teams concerned about feature regressions)
   - Move lower-priority modules to the flat SKU in two phases over 90 days
   - Keep critical modules grandfathered for 6 months
   - Credit schedule to offset unused modular credits at conversion points

Can you confirm: 1) target go-live month, 2) three highest-priority features you need to keep verbatim, and 3) whether procurement needs a formal quote or an MSA amendment first?

I attached a short PDF with example numbers based on your last 3 months of usage. If it helps, I can put together a clear TCO slide comparing current vs. flat at 6/9/12 month horizons.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Sven —

Appreciate the quick answers. Based on your requirements and the usage profile in the attach, here are two concrete proposals with figures (high-level):

A) Flat-Consolidation (straight conversion) — Quickest path (2–4 weeks)
   - Monthly flat SKU: $48k/month (seat + throughput pool) replacing current modular spend ~$52k/month
   - One-time conversion fee: $8k (covers entitlements migration + admin)
   - Immediate credit: prorated modular credit = $6.2k applied at conversion
   - Discount: 7% on list for a 12-month commitment
   - Risk: small feature surface mismatch for lower-priority modules (we map equivalents)

B) Phased-Slim (lower risk, phased) — Timeline 8–12 weeks
   - Month 0: move non-critical modules and apply a bridge credit equal to 50% of modular unused credits
   - Month 2: move critical modules after verification (grandfathering possible for specific workflows)
   - Effective monthly cost after phase-in: $50k/month, with a conversion fee of $4k
   - Discount: 5% for 12-months, with a 90-day rollback clause if key regressions found

Recommended next steps:
- If you prefer A: I can send a formal quote and a proposed amendment to the MSA.
- If you prefer B: I'll prepare a phased rollout plan and a short QA checklist for the teams to sign off.

I've attached the conversion scenarios PDF and a CSV of current entitlements so Ben/Priyom can validate the credit math. Priyom — can you confirm approval authority for up to 10% off list on conversion deals, and whether we can absorb half the conversion fee for deals under $300k ARR? Ben — any redlines we should expect on grandfathering?

Thanks,
Mina

Attachment: conversion-scenarios.pdf, current-entitlements.csv
